Markus — thanks, I'm on the 11/24 10am PT slot (blocked). A few notes I'll bring as a compact tech checklist in the kickoff:

- Attach acme-usage-snapshot.csv (sample traffic by endpoint + p95/p99 distribution) — helps pick batch-size targets.
- Batching: for their chat/generation endpoint, start with dynamic batching target of 8–12 tokens per request for p50 SLA 200–250ms; for embeddings use a 64–128 microbatch size with async flush.
- Caching: prefix (first N tokens) caching looks high-value for their product flows. Recommend TTLs: 30s for ephemeral queries, 24h for stable prompts. We'll demo a KV cache hit-rate dashboard in the console.
- Quantization: Priyom and I ran quick A/B on int8 vs int4 on a dev set. int8 preserved quality consistently; int4 showed a small uptick in F1 drop (esp. on name/entity recall). Suggest we ship int8 for launch; keep int4 as an escape for cost-pressure runs with increased sampling temperature and extra Nucleus filtering.
- Routing policy: primary region us-west with a warm failover to eu-west for low-latency markets; fallback policy should prefer model-variant (quantized vs full-precision) only if latency SLO exceeds threshold by >40% and we have <5% error rate.

I'll prepare two one-pagers to share in the kickoff: 1) batch/caching quick playbook, 2) recommended quant profiles + evaluation checklist.

Attachments: acme-usage-snapshot.csv

Grace
